subject: Eval-to-Close: POC environment sprint and gate checklist
messages:
From: Tara Rios <tara@bridgewell.health>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: alex.kim@horizon-labs.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff: environment needs & closing runway

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Bridgewell is ready to move to a short pilot. We want a tight MAP so we can conclude procurement by end of September. High-level asks from our infra team:

- Provide API keys scoped to a non-prod org.
- Org setup instructions (service accounts + roles).
- IP allowlist template for our NATed egress range.
- VPC peering guide (we use AWS us-west-2) and expected CIDR exchange.

I've attached a working spreadsheet with our ideal milestones (bridgewell_map_v1.1.xlsx) — please confirm which items you own vs. ours and whether a two-week POC runway (9/6–9/19) hits your SLOs.

Also copying Alex from our platform team — they'll coordinate the peering.

Thanks,
Tara
Tara Rios
Director, Platform Engineering
Bridgewell Health

Attachment: bridgewell_map_v1.1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 62KB)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Tara Rios <tara@bridgewell.health>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@horizon-labs.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: environment needs & closing runway

Tara — really appreciate the clear priorities. We can run the two-week POC with the MAP items you listed; below is what Redwood will deliver by 9/5 so you can hit the 9/6 start: 

Redwood deliverables (by Friday 2026-09-05):
- Provision non-prod org and create scoped API key pairs (one read-only eval key + one usage key for traffic).
- Sprint MAP doc with milestone owners and acceptance criteria (attached: network-allowlist-template.csv + internal MAP sheet).
- VPC peering guide and sample CloudFormation snippet for peer route setup (for AWS us-west-2).
- Short runbook for key rotation, rate limits, and fallback model variant.

Actions we need from Bridgewell by 9/3:
- Confirm the egress IP ranges (CSV OK) to populate the allowlist.
- Provide a technical contact for peering (Alex, confirmed?).
- Share preferred service account names/role mappings or we will propose defaults.

Proposed MAP cadence:
- 9/06: POC begin — baseline performance tests (latency + tokens/min).
- 9/10: Midpoint checkpoint — first quality sampling and cost burn review.
- 9/16: Final acceptance window — functional signoff on query coverage.
- 9/19: Target close — ops handoff + optional Dedicated capacity quote.

I attached the network allowlist template and stamped a first-pass MAP (internal sheet) so Monica and Neha can pick up delivery tasks. Monica will own the org/API provisioning and Neha will lead the peering runway.

Thanks — we’ll follow up with credentials via a secure channel (DocuSign/Drive share).

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0133

Attachments: network-allowlist-template.csv (csv), map_internal_notes.txt (text)

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP delivery tasks — org/API/VPC split

Sergio/Neha — quick internal sync so we don't duplicate work. Tasks I picked up:

- I will create the non-prod org, generate two API key pairs, and post the keys into the secure share (marked "POC-Bridgewell"). ETA: 2026-09-05 13:00 PDT.
- Neha: you own the VPC peering artifact and CF snippet; please validate the CIDR assumptions with Alex.
- Jonas: please prepare the baseline perf script and a small prompt set for the 9/06 run.

If anyone sees a blocker (IAM naming, quota limits), flag it here.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Thu, Sep 2, 2026 at 11:05 AM sergio_alvarez@redwood.com wrote:
> Tara — really appreciate the clear priorities. We can run the two-week POC with the MAP items you listed; below is what Redwood will deliver by 9/5 so you can hit the 9/6 start: 
> ...

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Tara Rios <tara@bridgewell.health>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@horizon-labs.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized MAP & POC runway — start 2026-09-06

Tara / Alex — thanks for the quick responses and for uploading the IP ranges (received 9/3). Confirming delivery and next steps for the POC runway: 

What Redwood delivered (complete):
- Non-prod org created: org-id rwdw-bridgewell-poc (credentials shared via secure Drive link).
- API keys provisioned: 1x eval-read, 1x usage-write (scopes documented).
- Network allowlist template completed and validated against your egress ranges (attached csv).
- VPC peering guide + CloudFormation snippet posted to the shared Drive (peering requires your acceptance of the request; see step 2 below).
- Baseline perf script and prompt set loaded into the repo for 9/06 run.

Bridgewell action items (open):
1) Accept the VPC peering request in your AWS console (request sent to the account emailed in the CF output).
2) Confirm timing for cutover window — we suggest a 30-min slot on 9/06 10:00–10:30 PDT for validation.
3) Provide one ops user for final acceptance test on 9/16.

Checkpoint dates (mutual):
- 2026-09-06: POC start — baseline tests run and initial smoke validated.
- 2026-09-10: Midpoint review (status + cost cadence) — remote sync 9/10 14:00 PDT.
- 2026-09-16: Final acceptance testing window.
- 2026-09-19: Contract close target / handoff.

If we hit the milestones, Sergio will coordinate the Dedicated quote and Monica will hand over runbooks for production. If anything slips, we fallback to the scoped eval key with default throttles to keep you online.

Thanks again — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: network-allowlist-template.csv (csv), map_finalized_notes.pdf (pdf)
